answers.explanation: Software-Defined Radio: tuning and modulation done in software.
Using AI to optimize performance and avoid interference.
Only a radio built in software can change its frequency on the fly.
You can't spot what's abnormal until you know what normal looks like.
Congestion and interference are what it watches for. It might move the WAP to another channel.
White space: spectrum that's free right now.
The same idea as a baseline or a known-good profile.
